thread:
jess: Quick PR to tighten SOC2 doc language around audit logs and retention: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978
omar: Skimmed. Please avoid vague wording like 'as needed'. Legal wants a numeric default retention and a path for enterprise extensions.
 tara: Suggest: 'Default retention: 90 days. Extended retention up to 7 years available via enterprise contract.'
jess: Added that exact sentence and a short SDK example for opting out of request-level logging:
```js
// disable audit logging for local tests
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, options: { auditLogging: false } });
```
omar: One technical note: change 'we redact PII before storage' to 'we apply automated PII detection and mask detected PII before long-term storage; transient processing may contain unmasked tokens that are encrypted and access-controlled.'
 tara: Also add a Dedicated migration note linking to /dedicated/retention-config.md and a bullet about auditor access (support ticket + SOW, time-limited, logged).
doc-bot: docs-ci: lint passed for PR #978  1 warning: unused frontmatter.
jess: I'll address the warning and merge once legal confirms the retention number. Thanks!
